summaries.Romania: Romania faces energy sector strain with nuclear plants offline and heatwave demand peaks, while healthcare innovation lags and political tensions simmer over salary law reforms. Critical infrastructure vulnerabilities are being exposed as Russia tests border security with drone incursions.
summaries.Healthcare: Gene therapy breakthroughs and AI-powered care tools are transforming treatment options, while healthcare systems grapple with behavioral health access and insurance coverage gaps. Innovation in rare disease treatment and preventive care is accelerating amid growing GLP-1 market disruption.
summaries.Tech: Apple's ecosystem faces competitive pressure with leaked products, EU app store concessions, and workforce reductions in Vision division, while AI companies race on multiple fronts from robotaxis to data training to enterprise adoption. Security vulnerabilities and supply chain attacks underscore ongoing infrastructure risks.

items.title: Ultragenyx Gene Therapy Becomes First FDA-Approved Treatment for Ultra-Rare Disease
items.snippet:
Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical’s Genglycos received accelerated FDA approval for glycogen storage disease type Ia, an inherited enzyme deficiency. It’s also the first approved gene therapy for Ultragenyx, which specializes in rare disease treatments. 
The post Ultragenyx Gene Therapy Becomes First FDA-Ap
items.line: FDA approval of first gene therapy for glycogen storage disease Ia marks breakthrough in ultra-rare genetic disease treatment.

items.title: Apple’s long-running app store battle with the EU appears to finally be over
items.snippet:
Apple’s long-running antitrust battle with the European Union over the sale of iPhone apps appears to finally be over. 
The EU has said that it welcomes the new app commission rates the company is offering within the bloc. The revised terms will see developers pay a commission or fee ranging from 5%
items.line: EU's acceptance of Apple's new app commission rates (5-30%) effectively ends multi-year antitrust battle over App Store practices.

items.title: Focal therapy for localized prostate cancer has divided physicians. Will new data change minds?
items.snippet: Urologic oncologists who treat prostate cancer are split over the benefits of focal therapy compared to traditional surgery or radiation.

items.title: GLP-1s are forcing a strategic reset across healthcare: Wells Fargo report
items.snippet: GLP-1s are disrupting a healthcare system built around treating obesity-related complications, forcing providers, insurers and investors to rethink where future revenue and growth will come from, according to a new report from Wells Fargo.
items.line: GLP-1 drugs forcing strategic reset across healthcare system threatens traditional revenue models for providers and insurers.
